reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation lies in the partially factorized variational Bayes (PFM-VB) approach, which retains the joint dependence between latent states θ_{1:T} and augmented variables z_{1:T} while factorizing only the marginal truncated-normal components. This allows for a computationally efficient approximation of the exact smoothing distribution, which is otherwise a high-dimensional truncated-normal CDF. The method leverages the Kalman smoother for the conditional distribution q(θ|z), ensuring exactness in the Gaussian state update step. The factorization of the truncated-normal part into univariate terms enables closed-form updates through coordinate ascent on the ELBO. The key insight is that full mean-field factorization (MF-VB) over-smooths the posterior and shrinks uncertainty, whereas PFM-VB preserves both mean and variance structure more accurately. This makes PFM-VB particularly suitable for GSE’s dynamic binary models where accurate uncertainty quantification is essential for real-time decision-making.
